thread:
Priya Nair: quick brain dump from today's sync - proposal for a staggered hedging layer between decision and enforcement. Purpose: avoid immediate full rollbacks, give controlled escape path, and make ownership explicit. flow: local detector -> local gatekeeper emits candidate decision -> hedger translates to timed, probabilistic enforcement -> router enforces.
Omar Haddad: main ask: define who can escalate from hedged -> full rollback. need escalation matrix (local owner vs global reconcilier).
Kara Liu: propose rule: local gatekeeper can enact soft hedges up to X% for Y mins. beyond that require global sign-off. default X=30%, Y=15m.
Theo Morales: add safety budgets per-tenant. hedges consume budget; if exhausted, auto-escalate to fallback. budget refill rules: daily window or proportional to healthy traffic.
Priya Nair: budget model sketch: tokens = healthy_req_count * safety_multiplier; spend = hedge_fraction * time_factor. will include numbers in RFC.
Omar Haddad: hedger should emit idempotent, timeboxed enforcement instructions: decision_id, step_ix, target_fraction, expires_at. router applies only newer sequences to avoid oscillation.
Kara Liu: add jitter to ramps to avoid synchronized ramps across regions, e.g. 0-30s randomized per instance.
ci-bot: test-run: hedger prototype ran integration: tenant="beta-inc" applied three-step hedge [70,50,20] with 10s jitter, p95 stabilized after second step. logs -> /artifacts/ci/2082129999/hedge-run.log
Theo Morales: hedger should use normalized signals (rates per-1000rps or percent deltas) and require two orthogonal signals before major escalations (latency+errors or drift+quality).
Priya Nair: require signal fusion: sample rule: if (latency>t && error_rate>e) OR (drift>q && quality_drop>m) then escalate. will include boolean expressions in DSL.
Omar Haddad: ops wants audit trail: decision_id, issued_by, owner, contributing_signals, intended_effect, actual_effects. hedger must log planned and observed outcome.
Kara Liu: policy DSL sketch: scope, max_soft_fraction, steps, step_duration_secs, escalation, budget, required_signals. example YAML fragment will be in RFC.
Theo Morales: API surface: POST /signals, POST /decisions (gatekeeper->hedger), GET /decisions/:id (audit), SSE /decisions/stream. include schema_v, decision_id, sequence, trace_id.
Kara Liu: add unstable_reason free text and confidence_scores array mapping to signals for explainability.
Priya Nair: testing plan: unit+integration+chaos: simulate observer loss, clock skew, partial partition where hedger can't reach router; router must respect TTL and revert to baseline when decision expires. add counterfactual sampling to verify hedges reduce impact.
Omar Haddad: ops request: expose hedge_state per-tenant in console and provide manual override (take ownership button) that inserts manual decision with priority and expires_at; manual preempts automated.
ci-bot: prototype supports manual override via POST /decisions with priority:manual in staging. logs -> /artifacts/ci/2082129999/manual-override.log
Priya Nair: next steps: Theo draft escalation matrix + budget formulas; Kara shape policy DSL and examples; Omar spec idempotency and sequencing; I'll collect and open RFC by Friday EOD. metrics to emit: hedge_steps_taken, hedge_success_rate, budget_consumed, decision_latency_ms. thanks all.
